svg.title: Sandmeyer chlorination: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: NO2− + acid → Nitrosating species (NO+ equivalent) + water. Acid generates a nitrosating electrophile; nitrous-acid protonation/dehydration and speciation are grouped.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Acid generates a nitrosating electrophile; nitrous-acid protonation/dehydration and speciation are grouped.
